rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an exact set of twelve.

example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 daa2 gai1 daan6

rows.note: Use this when “dozens” means many items, roughly several tens, rather than an exact count.

example.english: There were dozen after dozen of people waiting to get into the venue.
example.traditional: 會場入面有幾十個人等緊入場。
example.jyutping: wui6 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 sap6 go3 jan4 dang2 gan2 jap6 coeng4
